verdict.rationale: Ente Auth is an end-to-end encrypted 2FA code manager, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that calls external tools is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows any agent or tool-calling capability that would make this axis apply. The llms.txt and CLI probes concern machine-readable docs and export tooling, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
